result.title: Aggregation Dispersion: An Information-Geometric Diagnostic of Oversmoothing in Graph Neural Networks
result.comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
result.summary: Message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) learn node representations by iteratively aggregating information from neighbors, but stacking too many layers causes all representations to converge, an effect known as oversmoothing. We propose a geometric perspective on this phenomenon. At each depth $k$, the propagation operator assigns to every node $v$ a walk distribution $p_v^{(k)}$, a probability distribution over source nodes. These walk distributions form a point cloud on the probability simplex, whose contraction to a single point characterizes complete mixing of the propagation operator, and thus oversmoothing. To measure this contraction, we use the Fisher-Rao metric, the unique Riemannian metric on the simplex invariant up to scale under sufficient statistics, whose scaled chordal distance under the square-root embedding $p \mapsto \sqrt{p}$ is the Hellinger distance. The resulting diagnostic, the aggregation dispersion $D_k$, is the variance of the embedded point cloud on the unit sphere. We prove that: (i) $D_k = 0$ if and only if the $k$-th step propagation matrix has rank one, a necessary and sufficient condition for complete operator mixing; (ii) $D_k$ is non-increasing with depth; (iii) the spectral gap of the propagation matrix controls the rate of this decay; and (iv) for contractive MPNNs, the aggregation dispersion upper-bounds the representation dispersion up to graph- and initialization-dependent constants. Across 14 model configurations and 11 datasets, $D_k$ attains the highest mean absolute Pearson correlation with test accuracy across depths among eight diagnostics ($|r| = 0.721$, using log-transformed diagnostic values), numerically comparable to the post-training effective rank ($|r| = 0.688$), while requiring no training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从信息几何角度刻画 GNN 过平滑：把每层传播算子对应的游走分布视为概率单纯形上的点云，用平方根嵌入下的 Hellinger 距离构造「聚合弥散度」D_k，并证明其与传播矩阵秩一、随深度单调不增、受谱隙控制等性质，且在多个数据集上无需训练即可与测试精度相关。
AI.relevance_reason: 该深度方向上的表示弥散度指标无需训练即可度量状态坍缩程度，可能可供核查 latent/循环推理中推理状态随深度或迭代趋于同质化的问题；但图消息传递与视觉证据筛选场景的对应关系尚需验证。
